يكتنفان (form VIII)
# يَكْتَنِفَانِ (yaktanifāni) /jak.ta.ni.faː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# يُكْتَنَفَانِ (yuktanafāni) /juk.ta.na.faː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
